bear_assumptions: U.S. pharmacy and SNAP headwinds, food deflation and competition weaken comparable sales; labor and lease costs compress margin and cash returns slow.
base_assumptions: Low-single-digit sales growth, stable near-4% underlying margin, online growth and at least EUR2.3 billion free cash flow support covered dividends and buybacks.
bull_assumptions: Volume and pharmacy headwinds fade, online economics improve, margins expand modestly and cash returns compound per-share earnings without higher lease-adjusted leverage.
rating_change_conditions: Upgrade only if current evidence and an accepted relationship clear the canonical expected-return, downside-payoff and margin-of-safety gates; downgrade if volumes, margins or cash conversion weaken, lease-adjusted leverage rises, or distributions become uncovered.
